comparison_contract.required_parity: same genesis; aligned turns are compared descriptively
comparison_contract.reported: baseline/alternative commands, committed next-state metric differences, attributed-effect differences, and resolved-input parity
comparison_contract.fallbacks: different genesis, empty alignment, unequal transition counts, and unequal resolved inputs remain explicit
comparison_contract.causality: no causal certainty, ranking, probability, or strategy-value claim

presentation_surface.format: deterministic text-first post-run renderer used by the existing preset CLI demo
presentation_surface.browser_boundary: no browser route or new instructor authority path; CLI-only preset comparison

limits: This closes only the current descriptive counterfactual difference view.
The renderer does not recalculate either history or expose resolved-input values.
It does not establish causal validity, calibration, balance, learning, or human accessibility.
Distributional outcomes, export behavior, browser-native instructor surfaces, and human educational review remain separate gates.
